deleteChatConfirm: Delete this chat? You can't undo this.
welcome: Hi, I'm {{name}}. Ask me anything about your work across your apps, and I can guide you, find things, and run reports.
disclaimer: {{name}} only sees what you can see, and can make mistakes.

action.title: Needs your confirmation
action.automationNote: Your workspace's automation rules may run after this change, and they can send messages.
action.uncertain: The answer was lost on the way, so this may or may not have gone through. Checking what happened…
action.notSent: This didn't go through and nothing was changed. You can confirm it again.

outcome.failed: This didn't work, and nothing was changed.
outcome.unknown: This may or may not have gone through. Please check before trying again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.noCredits: Your workspace has run out of AI credits.
errors.rateLimited: You're sending messages quickly. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.dailyLimit: You've reached your daily Tia limit. It resets tomorrow.
errors.notInAudience: Your workspace admin has not enabled Tia for you.
errors.notInApp: Tia isn't turned on in this app. Your workspace admin can turn it on in Tia's setup.
errors.notConfigured: Tia has not been set up for this workspace yet.
errors.timeout: That took too long. Please try again.
errors.busy: Tia is already answering you in another tab or app. Try again when it's done.
errors.actionExpired: This request has expired. Please ask again.
errors.streamFailed: The answer was cut off. Your question wasn't sent twice; try again to see the reply.
errors.featureCap: Your workspace has reached today's limit for Tia. It resets tomorrow.
errors.providersDown: The AI service isn't answering right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.featureOff: Tia is switched off for this workspace.
errors.notFound: That chat or request can't be found any more.
errors.stillRunning: Still working on it. Check again in a moment; your question won't be sent twice.
errors.session: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.offline: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.creditsUnavailable: Your AI credits couldn't be checked right now, so nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
errors.settleFailed: Tia couldn't finish recording the credits for this answer, so it isn't shown. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.reportDataUpdating: The report data is being updated so that records held for review stay hidden. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.reportsNotConfigured: Reports aren't available right now because reporting isn't fully set up on this server. Please contact your administrator.
errors.entitlementsUnavailable: Your workspace's AI settings couldn't be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.contentBlocked: This answer was held back by the safety check, so it isn't shown.
errors.languageNotAllowed: This language isn't turned on for AI in your workspace.
errors.turnBudget: This needed more steps than one answer allows. Try asking for less at a time.
errors.invalidMessage: Tia couldn't read that message. Shorten it and try again.
errors.monthlyCap: Your workspace has reached this month's Tia limit. An admin can raise it in Tia settings.
errors.providerSetup: The AI service isn't set up correctly for this workspace, so Tia can't answer. Ask your workspace admin.
errors.policyInvalid: Your workspace's AI settings need attention before Tia can answer. Ask your workspace admin.
errors.duplicateRequest: That message is already being answered. Wait a moment before sending it again.

admin.defaultDescription: Helps your team find answers, run reports and get things done across your apps.
admin.defaultInstructions: Help staff with their work across our apps. Be clear and brief, and give step-by-step guidance when asked how to do something.
admin.accessHelp: By default only admins can use Tia: admin profiles have the "Chat with Tia" permission. To let other people use it, give their profile that permission in Settings under Profiles. Tia only ever sees what that person can already see.
admin.topicsHelp: Topic rules are checked by AI, so they are strong but not absolute. Permissions are what protect your data.
admin.limitHelp: Leave empty for no limit. Spending comes from your workspace's AI credits.
admin.deleteConfirmBody: Tia moves to the Recycle Bin and staff lose the assistant in every app. You can restore it from Settings → Data → Recycle Bin for 60 days.
admin.switchOffTitle: Tia is switched off for this workspace
admin.switchOffBody: Staff won't see Tia, even though it's deployed. Turn on "Tia" in the CRM app under Settings → AI Features. The launcher appears the next time staff open an app or return to its tab.
admin.switchUnknownTitle: Can't check whether Tia is switched on
admin.switchUnknownBody: The AI feature settings couldn't be read just now, so Tia may not appear for staff. Try again in a moment.
admin.limitScaleUnknown: Your workspace's credit settings can't be read with your access, so the limit can't be set here. Ask someone with billing access.
admin.limitScaleUnknownKept: A limit is set, but your workspace's credit settings can't be read with your access, so it can't be shown or changed here. Saving keeps it as it is.

chatGone: That chat no longer exists, so your message started a new one.
